description.value: Queensboro Pizza is a family-owned neighbourhood pizzeria established in 2000, specializing in Punjabi-style pizza — a distinctive fusion that sets it apart from typical pizza chains. Located in the Queensborough area of New Westminster, it has built a loyal local following over more than two decades. Cyclists passing through can phone ahead for a takeout order.
